event_data.context: Published Rust eventcore and eventcore-testing 2.1.0 packages confirmed the 1,000-event scenario observation boundary with a successful 1,001st event. Signed da3e953 adds release parity test, 89 tests passed, App approved. Awaiting exact CI. Shared bank account prototype passed memory and live PostgreSQL. Final audit identified a standalone filesystem coordination gap to verify and close.
event_data.summary: Port and verify the testing tools, examples, and parity verification capabilities of EventCore 2.1.0 on Erlang/OTP.
event_data.title: Testing tools, examples, and parity verification
